title: Come to Nothing
text: “First off, the fact that you, the Whip Hero, are carrying four weapons… I’ll let that slide. It seems the other Seven Star Heroes have already been dealt with, after all.”
“Give it back, you thief! You stole my weapon!”

“Wait, weren’t you the one who tried to take it first? Besides, if you’re carrying four Seven Star Weapons, that means you’ve killed at least three people. If I’m a thief, then you’re a murderer and a robber!”
“Shut up! I’m the Chosen One!”
That’s too bad. The Chosen One is your Father. The father of Filo-tan and the legendary Shield Hero. No one in the world is loved more than your Father.
“I’ve also heard you’re a reincarnated person. I get that you think you’re special, but we don’t have time to waste on this nonsense right now.”
“W-what do you mean by that!? So you’re just like them, aren’t you!”
“Them”? What on earth is this guy talking about? My Father looked at me, puzzled. “I’m afraid I don’t know,” I said, shaking my head.
“What are you talking about? Who are ‘those guys’?”
“Don’t play dumb! Everyone, turn this guy into a honeycomb!”
As Takt raised his arm, those pigs aimed their guns at us.
“Shooting Star Shield X! Listen to me!”
A hail of bullets flew toward us, but they were all deflected by Father’s Shooting Star Shield.
“What!? But this is nothing!”
Takt turns his gaze toward his pig minions. At the same time, he’s taking their guns and trying to fire them.
“Give Takt’s weapon back! It only has meaning when Takt holds it. It’s foolish for petty heroes like you to possess it!”
“That’s right! If you take someone else’s stuff, you’re a thief!”
“It’s disgusting that he’s bringing a Filolial along! I’ll never forgive this! You thief!”
“Thief, thief… Is that all you can say?! Anyway, since you know Takt is carrying another hero’s weapon, you have no right to say such things!”
Do you really think the attacks from the strongest of Takt’s pig-like minions could break through my Father’s defense? That’s impossible. Your puny little shots won’t even scratch my Father.

And as for that last guy—I can’t let him live. What are you going to do if Kou or Yuki-chan gets hurt? No matter how many lives like yours you offer up, it won’t make up for the emotional scars they’ll be left with.
“Give it back, you bastard! How dare you steal my weapon! That’s my power!”
“That’s exactly why! It’s not your power, is it? What’s the point of the world fighting at a time like this anyway!”
“Shut up! I’m the one who’s right, you thieving bastard! I’m the strongest!”
“Wait! You’re the one saying that!? Stealing other heroes’ weapons, hiding them, and hoarding them—and you think you’re right? Are you out of your mind!?”

Takt’s band of pigs each launch attacks at my Father’s Shooting Star Shield. However, the bullets fired from their guns are blocked by the Shooting Star Shield’s barrier and fall to the ground one by one.
“Unbelievable! It’s withstanding the bullets and attacks from my allies—all Level 200 or higher… you say! I’ll definitely take that power for myself!”
“It’s not just about taking it! Anyway, if we don’t work together to take on the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix, people all over the world are going to be in big trouble.”
“I said I, the strongest one here, will take care of everything! So give it back! Hand over the weapons too! This world belongs to me! You Four Sacred Heroes are the root of all this trouble!”
“That’s right! The world belongs to Takt!”
“What kind of gang of murderous robbers are these!?”

With a clang, clang, Takt is also trying to slash at my Father. There’s probably no one who deserves the word “foolish” more than these guys. They’re so foolish, it’s as if they’re on the exact opposite end of the spectrum from the very concept of intelligence.
“Everyone! If we break through this defensive wall, we can take his weapon. Then we’ll win!”
“‘Booh!’”
Even Father is squinting and furrowing his brow in irritation. I hope they manage to break through the defensive wall. But even if they do, it’ll be impossible to take Father’s weapon.
“‘The world is mine’… He really is exactly the kind of person Motoyasu-kun described. This is hopeless…”
“This is a lost cause.”
“Bro, aren’t these guys way more dangerous than the Spirit Tortoises? They seem to be seriously thinking about world conquest.”
“They’re like kids who just grew to giant size… I wonder if there wasn’t a single person around to warn them.”
“If anyone had warned them, they would surely have been killed. Lady Melty said that’s just how foolish rulers are.”

I agree with Yuki-chan, as well as Keel and the Panda Beastman’s analysis. That’s pretty much the gist of it. They’ve probably slaughtered everyone who tried to warn them. Just as Keel said, they’re more troublesome than even a clumsy Spirit Tortoise.
“Wooooooooooooooooooooooooooah!”
Shouting things like that, Takt is desperately attacking my Father’s Shooting Star Shield. It hasn’t budged an inch.
“What’s with the ‘Wooooo’… So, what are we going to do? We’re already under attack, after all.”
“Well then, I’ll take care of this.”
I held my arms out horizontally in front of Takt, bent my left leg, and jumped off my right foot. It’s a pose that looks like I’m bouncing around, like Filolial-sama. Then I shouted,
“Takt, how do you feel right now? How does it feel to try to take your opponent’s weapon only to have it taken from you instead?”
“Wait—”
My Father was speechless at my words.
“Ah! That looks fun. Let Kou join in, too!”
“Sure thing. Let’s do it together.”
Kou, standing next to me, said to Takt, whose face had turned bright red:
“Hey, how does it feel? Kou wants to know! Tell me!”
“Hah! Oh no… I can’t hold it in! Wahahahahaha!”
My father burst out laughing and was clutching his stomach. I kept going just to see his smile.

“Y-o-u’re-j-o-k-i-n-g w-i-t-m-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-
Joking aside, I’ve finished the incantation, and now I’m casting the Magic. This time, I’ll wipe you all out in one shot so you can’t escape.
“Liberation Flame Floor X!”

This is the real deal—Magic that traps the entire area in a sea of flames, leaving no one alive outside Father’s barrier. Originally, it’s a spell that boosts the power of fire magic, but when deployed at high density, it quickly transforms into an attack akin to being roasted in an oven.

The range is this room. It’s a single strike that will burn everything in the designated area to a crisp. I made sure to handle things so the airship could be recycled as much as possible, and this time, I won’t let those pigs escape.
“W-waaaahhhhhhh—”

In an instant, the room was engulfed in flames, and Takt evaporated right before my eyes. That’s one less thing to worry about. As long as the Queen and the representative from Siltvelt handle things well—and since we’ve also taken out the representative from Shieldfreeden—war should be avoidable. Amidst all this chaos, at least this part went according to plan.
“Ah… I do think I might have gone a bit too far, but since they were high-level enemies blasting away with guns, I think self-defense will hold up.”
My father is staring at the blazing room as if he’s given up.
“Or rather… maybe they mistook us for some kind of boss where you get a weapon if you defeat me or Motoyasu? You know, like in action games? Wait, Motoyasu probably wouldn’t get that.”
“I don’t know the details of the game, but I understand what you’re getting at, Father. You’re absolutely right.”

“Even in a situation like this, he’s thinking about stealing the opponent’s weapon? What on earth is he thinking? To top it off, he talks as if he’s going to take it, and then if someone takes it from him, he calls them a thief… Just like Motoyasu-kun said, he really wasn’t a decent person.”
“His tactics are as one-dimensional as a fool’s. Luring us out for All Cannon Fire, then unleashing his Skills.”
“That’s why I neutralized his tactics first. But it seems he was still trying to take it after All Cannon Fire.”
“Well… since he’s not stuck in a loop like Motoyasu-kun, I guess it can’t be helped? I think he’d change his tactics if the situation were different.”

My father let out a deep sigh. Is that so? It’s been the exact same pattern every time so far. I’m sure he’d use the same attack again if there were a next time. In that case, it wouldn’t be a bad idea for us to strike first if there is a next time.
“I thought, depending on the negotiations, he might cooperate…”
“No chance. I don’t think Takt acknowledges anyone stronger than himself. The only thing on his mind is finding a way to defeat anyone stronger than him.”
“Judging by that reaction, I can’t deny it… Hmm?”
My father stares into the blazing room. I stare into it too. Then, a single shadow flickers and approaches.
“Ah… how foolish… our dreams… Takt… has… reduced them to nothing… in an instant.”
I believe that’s the dragon Takt used to keep.
“It’s the Dragon Emperor!”

Rival assumes a threatening stance behind my Father. The Assistant huddles close to Rival, trembling with fear. That’s right. The very fact that they’re alive amidst these intense flames is a miracle in itself.
“You’re still alive? Get yourself to the afterlife already!”

Since killing you will allow me to perform the ritual to break through my limits, just die already. Just as I was about to channel my power into the spear and take aim—we saw Takt’s dragon’s aura gradually swelling.
“B-bro! He’s giving off a crazy intimidating vibe!”
“Yeah, you’re right. There’s an overwhelming sense of pressure coming from him like never before. Let’s finish him off quickly!”
Keel and the panda beastman muttered anxiously.
“Ugh… Who cares! To you lot who crushed our dreams and Takt’s—if I can just kill you… I won’t hesitate to use any means necessary!”
“Brionac X!”

I unleashed the finishing move, Brionac, at Takt’s dragon. But just as I was about to finish it off, Takt’s dragon began to swell before our very eyes, and my Father and I heard a familiar “pop” sound.
In our field of vision—a blue hourglass engraved with the number “10” appeared.

*This is a response to a comment in the feedback section. Among Motoyasu’s subordinates, there are some who stand out from the rest. These are individuals whose appearances are quite different from those of ordinary people. Specifically, they are the Dragon Emperor, the Griffin, the Nine-Tailed Fox, and the Beastman.
